title: phonometry catalogue document, schema version 1
description: A catalogue of your own: the rows of one table of a data sheet, a declaration of performance, a test report or a measurement, which phonometry.io.read_catalogue reads into rows of the named class; or the header beside a CSV file, which declares its dialect and holds no rows. Written by phonometry.io.catalogue_schema. The reader holds a document to more than its form: what depends on two cells at once is its alone.

$schema.description: Where an editor finds this schema. The reader never reads it.

catalogue.description: The catalogue's name, the first half of every key: never a four-digit year followed by a word, which is the form of the packaged tables' names.

row_type.description: The row class every row of the document is read into.

about.description: What the document is, how it was read and in which units it prints.

basis.description: The basis of every row that does not give its own.

conventions.description: The notes and legends the document prints for the whole table.

phonometry_version.description: The version that wrote the file. Never read.

hedge.basis.description: What the source says a value is: field (or row) to measured, declared, calculated, estimated or extended.

hedge.borrowed.description: Field to the material the page takes the value from.

hedge.bounded_above.description: The fields of ranges the page prints as <= x or < x.

hedge.bounded_below.description: The fields of ranges the page prints as >= x or > x.

hedge.carried.description: Field to where the page gives it from, for a cell it prints blank and carries from another row.

hedge.converted.description: Field to [figure, unit] the page prints, for a value you converted from a unit the reader has no alias for.

hedge.misprinted.description: Field to what the page prints there and why it cannot be served.

hedge.not_derivable.description: Field to why it is left empty although it could be worked out.

hedge.ranges.description: Field to [low, high] for a cell the page prints as an interval; null for an open end.

hedge.reported.description: Field to the readings the page lists, with no single value: numbers or intervals [low, high].

hedge.uncertainty.description: Field to the plus-or-minus the page prints beside the value.

hedge.unquantified.description: Field to what the page prints where the number would be.

number_from_0.description: A number that is never negative, as no quantity in the unit its field's name ends in is, or null.

number_from_0_to_1.description: A number from 0 to 1, the values the quantity its field names can take, or null.

number_from_0_to_100.description: A number from 0 to 100, the values the quantity its field names can take, or null.

prose.description: A paragraph or more of text.

kind.description: What kind of document the cells were read from.

document.description: The document's title as it prints it.

consulted.description: The day the document was read, as YYYY-MM-DD.

issued.description: When the document says it was issued: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, at the precision it prints.

url.description: Where the document was found. Never opened by the reader.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 digest of the file that was read, in hexadecimal.

reading.description: One reading: a number, or an interval [low, high].
